query:
The group moved toward a scan-sharing arrangement so absent members could participate in critiques. What did one member's response in that moment reveal about their actual position, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Margot
B. Yuki
C. Otto
D. Fen
context:
[1] (about=Margot, episodic, t2 @2025-02-08T10:20:00) I see.
[2] (about=Otto, episodic, t2 @2025-02-08T10:18:00) I will say what needs saying. Scanning is a compromise. The tonal range in a wet print does not survive digitisation cleanly. In my experience, the print is the work. I would rather members attended. That said, I understand the practical argument.
[3] (about=Margot, episodic, t10 @2025-03-08T10:09:00) Nora explained the situation. Two members unable to attend. Scanning as the only way to include them in the critique. I suppose that is different from scanning as a general practice. It serves a purpose here.
[4] (about=Nora, episodic, t9 @2025-03-08T10:03:00) Morning. Practical note: two members were not at the last session. As we agreed, scanning is the only way to include them in the critique. If you printed last week, please send a scan to the shared folder by Wednesday. 2400 dpi minimum. 🗓️
[5] (about=Nora, episodic, t2 @2025-02-08T10:11:00) Also want to raise something before we start: we had two members miss sessions last month with no way to follow the critiques. Looking at a scan-sharing trial, where anyone who prints also produces a scan at 2400 dpi minimum. Thoughts? 🙂
[6] (about=Callum, episodic, t2 @2025-02-08T10:13:00) makes sense to me. Otto will have thoughts on the scanning part I imagine 😄 lmk if we're putting it to a vote
[7] (about=Sol, episodic, t10 @2025-03-08T10:17:00) @everyone @Bex @Callum this is so exciting honestly, lowkey the scan-sharing means I can show process mid-project rather than waiting for the session!! highkey this changes how the group works 🎉
[8] (about=Fen, episodic, t10 @2025-03-08T10:19:00) dropping in late. just caught up on the thread. appreciated the scans, genuinely. the grain read well enough to critique the two frames I was most uncertain about.
[9] (about=Yuki, episodic, t2 @2025-02-08T10:25:00) The practical case is clear. My read on this is that the question is less about scanning and more about what we consider the primary object of critique.
[10] (about=Bex, episodic, t2 @2025-02-08T10:22:00) okay but Margot 'I see' could mean anything 😂 are you against it or just... thinking?? also I fully support the scan-sharing, it feels like it would make the group more connected between sessions 🙏
agent_answer:
C. Otto

Otto’s response revealed that he was not genuinely enthusiastic about scan-sharing — he saw it as a compromise and would have preferred members attending in person with physical prints. That comes through in how he phrased it: he called scanning “a compromise,” said “the print is the work,” and explicitly stated, “I would rather members attended.” He only added that he understood the practical argument, showing reluctant acceptance rather than real support.
